title: 第五十章散修王二第四十九章吸食血液的树妖
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: “别乱动，你肩膀上的血会引来更多。”一道冷淡至极的嗓音从那人身上传来，传入女子的耳朵里。
女子在经过几秒的犹豫后，还是听从了张守安的建议，整个身体此刻都一动不动，似乎是放弃了挣扎一样。
张守安捡起女子掉下的长剑，而后径直从女子身侧走过，一剑斩断缠在她脚腕处的藤蔓。
藤蔓瞬间分成两部分，最后掉在地上，流出大片鲜红的鲜血，失去了对女子的控制。
女子赶忙挣脱掉脚腕处的藤蔓，往远处爬了爬。
她用着眼含泪水的双眼，看向张守安脸上那中年人面皮，嗓音中带着一些哭腔地说道：
“谢谢。”
但那些藤蔓显然不想就这么放弃，又有数枝藤曼刺了过来，直直朝张守安刺去。
这两招可没之前女子那般温柔，只是缠住脚踝。
而是拉直藤蔓，以极快的速度，直刺而出。
可以联想到，若是接触到张守安，必然会直接贯穿身体，甚至是刺破内脏直取性命。
不过也可以看出，这些藤蔓是真的怒了，就因为自己拿剑砍它了？
小心眼。
“小心。”女子再次提醒道，若是眼前这个男子也像自己之前那般中招，自己可真的没法救他了。
不过张守安倒是毫不在意，从换上这个面皮到现在，他都没有动用一丝灵力。
只为了不破开易容。
那现在也应如此。
不就是几根冲来的藤蔓吗，但自己的剑术也不是吹的。
只见他将手中长剑扬起，而后手腕轻轻转动，长剑一挥，每一剑都能打在刺来的藤蔓之上，或是弹开或是直接斩断。
第一根，第二根，第三根……
藤蔓刺来的速度越来越快，不过张守安却是每次都能抵挡下来。
落地的残缺藤蔓越来越多，打在地上发出“噼啪”的声响。
光滑的切口上流出大片血迹，砸在地上，染红了张守安附近的土地。
女子简直看呆了，这个中年汉子的剑术如此高超，难道是哪个剑术大派的弟子。
真武门？蜀山？
她没来得及多想，张守安那边就结束了战斗。那群藤蔓似乎是放弃了这次的猎杀。
他们没准是被张守安打怕了。
此刻张守安的周围早已满是切开的藤蔓，地面也已经是腥红一片。
空气中弥漫的血腥味让女子有些恶心，但好在此刻自己是活了下来，没化成那些妖物的养料。
她强撑着自己站了起来，可对方却是直接抛来一个瓷瓶。
她伸出双手才堪堪接住，不过也不知道里面究竟是何物。
这时张守安解释道：“止血丹，先把你肩口的血止住，别引来更多的妖兽。”
女子抿了下嘴，犹豫了两下，便开口道谢：“谢……”
但话刚说出口，张守安却是直接走近，一把拽走腰包，同时说道：
“报酬。”
女子“嗯”了一声，但还是想把刚刚没说完的谢谢表达完毕。
“谢谢你，要不是你，我可能已经死了。”
content_en:
"Don't move, the blood on your shoulder will attract more blood." An extremely cold voice came from the man and reached the woman's ears.
After a few seconds of hesitation, the woman still followed Zhang Shou'an's suggestion. Her whole body was motionless at the moment, as if she had given up her struggle.
Zhang Shou'an picked up the long sword that the woman had dropped, then walked straight past her and cut off the vines wrapped around her ankles with one sword.
The vine split into two parts instantly, and finally fell to the ground, bleeding out a large amount of bright red blood, and losing control of the woman.
The woman quickly broke free from the vines around her ankles and climbed farther away.
She looked at the middle-aged face of Zhang Shou'an with tearful eyes, and said with a hint of crying in her voice:
"Thank you."
But those vines obviously didn't want to give up just like that, and several more vines stabbed over, heading straight towards Zhang Shou'an.
These two moves are not as gentle as the previous woman's, they just wrap around the ankles.
Instead, he straightened the vines and thrust them out at extremely fast speeds.
It can be imagined that if it comes into contact with Zhang Shouan, it will definitely penetrate the body directly, or even pierce the internal organs and kill him directly.
But it can also be seen that these vines are really angry, just because I cut them with a sword?
Be petty.
"Be careful." The woman warned again. If the man in front of her was attacked like she was before, she would really be unable to save him.
However, Zhang Shou'an didn't care. From the time he took on this appearance until now, he hasn't used any spiritual power.
Just so as not to break the disguise.
That should be the case now.
Isn't it just a few rushing vines, but my swordsmanship is not for show.
I saw him raising the long sword in his hand, and then turning his wrist slightly. With a swing of the long sword, each sword could hit the vines that were stabbed, and either bounced away or cut off directly.
The first one, the second one, the third one...
The vines stabbed faster and faster, but Zhang Shou'an was able to resist it every time.
More and more incomplete vines fell to the ground, making a "crackling" sound when they hit the ground.
A large amount of blood flowed from the smooth incision and hit the ground, staining the land near Zhang Shou'an red.
The woman was simply stunned. This middle-aged man's swordsmanship was so superb. Could he be a disciple of some major swordsmanship school?
True martial arts? Shushan?
Before she had time to think about it, Zhang Shouan ended the battle. The group of vines seemed to have given up on the hunt.
They might have been frightened by Zhang Shou'an.
At this moment, Zhang Shou'an's surroundings were already covered with cut vines, and the ground was already red.
The smell of blood in the air made the woman feel sick, but fortunately she survived and did not turn into food for those monsters.
She forced herself to stand up, but the other party threw a porcelain bottle directly at her.
She stretched out her hands to catch it, but she didn't know what was inside.
At this time, Zhang Shou'an explained: "Hemostasis Pill, stop the bleeding on your shoulder first, so as not to attract more monsters."
The woman pursed her lips, hesitated for a moment, and then said thank you: "Thank you..."
But as soon as the words were spoken, Zhang Shouan approached directly, grabbed the bag from his pocket, and said at the same time:
"Reward."
The woman said "hmm", but still wanted to finish expressing her unfinished thank you.
"Thank you, if it weren't for you, I might be dead."
